manifest.name: @wuzhican/dsh-qbittorrent
manifest.description: DSH 插件：把 qBittorrent WebAPI v2 注册成模型可直接调用的工具，用于查询种子、排查卡死的下载记录；写入类操作需显式 confirm。
manifest.author: wuzhican

bundle.text:
# Bundle patch: inserts this plugin into the profile roster.
#
# The row points at the plugin's own package, so installation carries no
# absolute path and works on any machine.
#
# Optional config keys (all may be omitted):
#   url        qBittorrent WebUI origin, default http://127.0.0.1:8080
#   tokenRef   credential name holding the Bearer token, default QBT_API_KEY
#   timeoutMs  per-request deadline, default 30000
- insert:
    - id: qbittorrent
      name: '@wuzhican/dsh-qbittorrent'
      config: {}

readme.text:
English | [中文](README.zh.md)

A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin that registers qBittorrent's WebAPI v2 as
model-facing tools: list and inspect torrents, triage stuck downloads, and
apply a small set of guarded mutations. No browser window, no MCP subprocess —
the tools are registered natively through `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools`.

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add @wuzhican/dsh-qbittorrent
```

Restart `dsh web` if the profile does not compose patches on reload.

The plugin works with no configuration. Every key is optional and can be set
in the patch row's `config`:

| Key | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `url` | `http://127.0.0.1:8080` | qBittorrent WebUI origin (`QBT_URL` env also honoured) |
| `tokenRef` | `QBT_API_KEY` | Credential name holding the Bearer token (`QBT_TOKEN_REF` env also honoured) |
| `timeoutMs` | `30000` | Per-request deadline |

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: qbittorrent
      name: '@wuzhican/dsh-qbittorrent'
      config:

**The token is never stored in a patch file.** It is resolved through the DSH
credential service by name, falling back to `process.env`. qBittorrent v5.2.x
accepts only `Authorization: Bearer <token>` here; `X-API-Key`, `api-key` and
query-parameter forms all return 403.

| Tool | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `qb_status` | Version, WebAPI version, per-state torrent counts, transfer stats |
| `qb_list_torrents` | List with `filter` / `category` / `tag` / `hashes` / `sort`, capped at 200 items |
| `qb_torrent_detail` | One torrent's properties plus file list |
| `qb_list_categories` | Every category and its save path |
| `qb_find_orphans` | Torrents whose metadata never resolved, whose name is still the bare infohash, or that error / miss files |
| `qb_resume_torrent` | Resume — requires `confirm: true` |
| `qb_pause_torrent` | Pause — requires `confirm: true` |
| `qb_set_category` | Move into a category — requires `confirm: true` |
| `qb_delete_torrent` | Remove — requires `confirm: true` plus `expect` matching the hash count; max 20 per call; `deleteFiles: true` also erases data on disk |

Write calls refuse to run without `confirm: true`. An API failure returns as a
tool result rather than an exception, so one bad call does not end the turn.

A GitHub Release carries a version-free `dsh-qbittorrent.tgz` built by CI, for prebuilt installs.

- DSH `>=0.2.0-rc.1`
- Node >= 18 (global `fetch` and `AbortSignal.timeout`)
- qBittorrent WebAPI v2 with an API token

No runtime dependencies. `@deepseek-ai/cordis` and `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` are
peer dependencies supplied by the harness.
